source: Interface Chair
target: 接口座椅

source: Neural Processors
target: 神经处理器

source: Helmet
target: 头盔

source: Green Globe
target: 绿色球体

source: &1720 My God...they actually did it...
target: &1720 天哪……他们真的做成了……

source: &1262 Wow...talk about organic computing...
target: &1262 哇……这才叫有机计算……

source: &602 Whoa...what is this stuff?
target: &602 哇……这是什么东西？

source: &657 You wonder whether you should have stopped her.
target: &657 你不禁想，是否应该阻止她。

source: &2029 I'm not certain, but based on its connections to the organic circuitry, it's probably an interface system.
target: &2029 不确定，不过看它跟有机电路的连接，应该是某种接口系统。

source: &1496 I'm hesitant to guess, since I've only heard of them academically, but this looks like a neural interfacing terminal.
target: &1496 只在学术资料里听说过，不敢贸然猜。但看起来，这是神经接入终端。

source: &1497 The kind used before everyone was wired, anyway.
target: &1497 至少，是大家还没装神经接口之前用的那种。

source: &725 Hey, I know what this is, they used these for connecting to the Trance in the old days.
target: &725 嘿，我知道这个。以前，人们用它接入迷境。

source: &726 Man, life before wetware neural-wiring must have been hard.
target: &726 没有湿件神经接口的年代，生活可真不容易。

source: &1721 No way in Hell am I getting in that thing...
target: &1721 打死我，也不会进那东西……

source: &1263 I'd want to run a diagnostic before trying that.
target: &1263 试之前，我得先做诊断。

source: &661 Though the room is full of these globes of neural tissue, this one looks sicklier than the others.
target: &661 房间里全是神经组织球体，可这个比其他的显得更病弱。

source: &662 Without its globe, all that remains is a withered stalk.
target: &662 没了球体，只剩一根枯萎的茎。

source: &663 Filling a space of about a cubic metre, you realize you'd never be able to carry this sac. The fluid inside must weigh about a metric ton.
target: &663 这个囊袋占了大约一立方米的空间，你知道，自己不可能带走。里面的液体，大概就重一吨。

source: &665 The sphere's contents leak into the innards of the network, leaving only its empty skin.
target: &665 球体里的东西流入网络内部，只留下空皮囊。

source: &666 The power to the security's already been disabled. Better not mess with it any more.
target: &666 安保电源已经切断，最好别再乱动。

source: &140 Power conduit Alpha: Temporary shutdown.
target: &140 Alpha供电线路：暂时关闭。

source: &43 Power conduit Alpha: Temporary shutdown.
target: &43 Alpha供电线路：暂时关闭。

source: &736 According to the readout on the screens, the organic systems are running within tolerances.
target: &736 屏幕读数显示，有机系统正在容许范围内运行。

source: &737 The screens won't control anything - they're just data-readouts.
target: &737 这些屏幕不能控制任何东西，只是读数显示。

source: &2030 I ran tests on the prototypes for this stuff in the lab...I never thought they'd make so much of it...
target: &2030 我在实验室测试过这些东西的原型……没想到，他们会造出这么多……

source: &1498 The organic component of Central's mind.
target: &1498 中枢心智的有机部分。

source: &1499 I wonder if Regis has realized that this...matter...probably shares a lot of DNA with him.
target: &1499 不知道里吉斯有没有意识到，这些……组织……可能跟他共享着大量DNA。

source: &727 What *is* this stuff? It sure isn't wetware...
target: &727 这*到底*是什么？肯定不是湿件……

source: &2031 I've had enough of this stuff.
target: &2031 这种东西，我已经受够了。

source: &1500 I'd have no idea where to begin. Biologicals are Regis' thing.
target: &1500 完全不知道该从哪里下手。生物的部分，是里吉斯的领域。

source: &728 This stuff's probably got amazing processing power, but they're not going to let me take it as a souvenir.
target: &728 处理能力肯定惊人，不过他们不会让我带回去当纪念品。
